purpose: Provide a nonmodal resizable bottom panel inside a bounded workspace.
behaviorProvider: Native in-flow region and separator with ResizeObserver, pointer capture and keyboard resizing.

component: close requests and conditional focus return

requirements.statement: Render in normal document flow without a portal, modal backdrop or focus trap; closed panels return null and unmount their content.
Support controlled open and height callbacks or local default values. Close requests update local state only when open is uncontrolled.
Measure the parent and panel margins with ResizeObserver, reserve workspaceMinHeight, and clamp rendered height between the available bounds.

Use primary-pointer drag to change height and a focusable horizontal separator exposing current/min/max pixel values. ArrowUp grows, ArrowDown shrinks, Shift uses the larger step, and Home/End choose bounds.
Close through the named close button or an unhandled Escape from within the panel. Stop active drag on pointer completion/cancellation, lost capture, blur or closing.

Capture the active opener when opening. When closing or unmounting after focus was inside, restore it only if connected and the document body still owns focus; do not override a new host focus target.
Provide a measurable bounded parent workspace and finite meaningful height constraints. Keep controlled height/open values in sync with callbacks.
Preserve drafts outside the unmounted panel when needed, supply an informative title and handle route transitions or initial content focus; opening does not move focus into the panel automatically.
Own pattern or component styling consumes surface group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: This is an in-flow nonmodal panel, not a viewport drawer or modal dialog.
No automatic initial focus, route integration or persistence of unmounted content.
Host sizing props must be finite and coherent; unlike Sheet helpers this implementation does not normalize every nonfinite input.
